learning_outcomes.text: Develop ability to effectively use information search languages
Implement a solution applying the concepts learned

syllabus_topics: Transposition of a conceptual model to a relational model

assessment_methods.method: Group project, with two phased deliveries

assessment_rules: For approval, a minimum grade of 8.00 points (out of 20) is required for the project and the test, without rounding. If the student fails or does not reach the minimum grade in the individual written test, they can repeat this component during the second period. There is no possibility of new deliveries or repetitions for project components and online interim tests. Students wishing to improve their grade can take an exam during the second period. Students who did not successfully complete the continuous assessment with an average grade greater than or equal to 10 (out of 20) take a final exam (100% individual written test, without consultation).
